items.exampleEn: Can you put the story in a nutshell for me?
items.exampleZh: 你可以把這個故事簡單地說給我聽嗎？

items.exampleEn: This bed set comes with a sheet and two matching pillowcases.
items.exampleZh: 這組寢具附一條床單和兩個成套的枕頭套。

items.exampleEn: The art teacher handed each student a paintbrush and a cup of water.
items.exampleZh: 美術老師發給每位學生一支畫筆和一杯水。

items.exampleEn: The new bridge has a metal handrail on both sides.
items.exampleZh: 新橋兩側都有金屬扶手。

items.exampleEn: Many visitors love the coziness of small mountain cafes in winter.
items.exampleZh: 許多遊客喜歡冬天山上小咖啡館的溫馨感。

items.exampleEn: Wallboard is light, cheap and easy to cut to size.
items.exampleZh: 牆板又輕又便宜，而且很容易裁成需要的大小。

items.exampleEn: I clean the birdcage every Saturday and give the birds fresh water.
items.exampleZh: 我每個星期六都會清理鳥籠，給鳥換上乾淨的水。

items.exampleEn: At the museum, a doorkeeper checks every visitor's ticket.
items.exampleZh: 在博物館，門房會檢查每位參觀者的票。

items.sentenceEn: Please hold the handrail when you walk down these stairs.
items.sentenceZh: 走下這段樓梯時，請扶著扶手。

items.audioEn: I need a wider paintbrush to finish painting this wall before dinner.
items.audioZh: 我需要一支比較寬的刷子，才能在晚餐前把這面牆漆完。

items.sentenceEn: So, in a nutshell, we need more staff for the busy season.
items.sentenceZh: 所以簡單來說，旺季我們需要更多人手。

items.sentenceEn: The doorkeeper opened the gate and welcomed us with a smile.
items.sentenceZh: 門房打開大門，笑著歡迎我們。

items.stemEn: The parrot sat in its ____ and copied every word we said.
items.stemZh: 那隻鸚鵡待在牠的鳥籠裡，模仿我們說的每一個字。

items.stemEn: She washed her ____ in warm water after painting the fence.
items.stemZh: 她漆完圍欄後，用溫水把刷子洗乾淨。

items.passageEn: When I moved into my first apartment, it felt cold and empty. Over one weekend, I tried to change that. I fixed a hole in the wallboard and took out my paintbrush to paint the bedroom a soft yellow. I bought linen pillowcases and a thick rug for the floor. My neighbor gave me an old birdcage, which I filled with small plants. The building's friendly doorkeeper even helped me carry a lamp up the stairs, holding the handrail with one hand. In a nutshell, it took a little work and very little money, but now the apartment has a real coziness.
items.passageZh: 我搬進第一間公寓時，感覺又冷又空。我花了一個週末想改變這一點。我補好牆板上的一個洞，拿出刷子把臥室漆成柔和的黃色。我買了亞麻枕頭套，還有一塊厚地毯鋪在地上。鄰居送我一個舊鳥籠，我在裡面放滿了小盆栽。大樓親切的門房甚至一手扶著扶手，幫我把一盞燈搬上樓。簡單來說，只花了一點工夫、沒花多少錢，現在這間公寓就充滿了溫馨感。

questions.questionZh: 作者把舊鳥籠拿來做什麼？

items.promptZh: 簡單來說，這個計畫太貴了。
referenceEn: In a nutshell, this plan is too expensive.
In a nutshell, the plan costs too much.
rubricZh: 要用 in a nutshell 表達「簡單來說」
沒有時間標記，現在式或過去式都可以；「太貴」可寫 too expensive、costs too much 等

items.promptZh: 我把枕頭套拆下來，丟進洗衣機裡。
referenceEn: I took off the pillowcase and put it in the washing machine.
I took the pillowcase off and threw it into the washing machine.
rubricZh: pillowcase 指「枕頭套」（例如 the pillowcase、my pillowcase 等）
「拆下來」可寫，例如 took off、removed 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 took、take 等）
